newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC raises soft wheat stocks, cuts barley.
newsitem.headline: ONIC raises soft wheat stocks, cuts barley.

text.p: France's ONIC grain office confirmed on Wednesday it had raised its estimates for 1996/97 soft wheat carryover stocks and had cut the estimate for barley stocks.
In a monthly supply/demand report, it put soft wheat carryover stocks at 2.510 million tonnes compared with a previous figure of 2.268 million.
It pegged the barley carryover at end June at 807,000 tonnes against 873,000 tonnes forecast last month. The changes were in line with expectations.
Last year's carryover was 2.204 million tonnes for soft wheat and 626,000 tonnes for barley.

The report showed ONIC cut 1996/97 soft wheat exports to non-EU countries to 6.25 million tonnes from 6.30 million last month. ONIC also cut its target for soft wheat exports to other EU partners to 9.37 million tonnes from 9.42 million last month.
It also revised total supplies, after on-farm consumption, to 33.19 million tonnes from 33 million.

It raised barley exports to other EU partners to 2.475 million tonnes from the 2.37 million forecast last month and cut its target for barley exports to non-EU countries to 1.55 million tonnes from 1.6 million last month.
